0022600196.text: The Chicago Bulls (1-6, 13th in the East) host the Philadelphia 76ers (7-1, 1st in the East), who are on a four-game winning streak after a strong start. Philadelphia won the teams' only 2026-27 meeting 126-107 in Philadelphia on November 2, so the Bulls trail 0-1 this season, though Chicago won the 2025-26 series 2-1. Chicago is without Nic Claxton (hamstring strain), while Philadelphia is missing Ariel Hukporti (Achilles, surgery) and Dominick Barlow (back, fracture).
